title: NGS Library Pooling Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare CSV and Labware List
steps.instruction: Create a `.csv` file (including the header line) that lists the source well of the elution plate (located in slot 9) and the transfer volume in µL for each sample, e.g. `A1,4` `A2,3` `A3,5.3` `A4,6.4`. Gather the following consumables: Eppendorf twin.tec 96‑well PCR plate 150 µL (catalog #0030128605), Opentrons temperature module with a 4 × 6‑well aluminum block insert, Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack with a 4 × 6 insert for 2 mL Eppendorf snap‑cap tubes (or equivalent), Opentrons 10 µL and 200 µL filter tip racks, and Opentrons GEN1 P10 and P300 single‑channel electronic pipettes.

steps.title: Load Water and Pool Tubes
steps.instruction: Place a 4 × 6 tuberack containing 2 mL Eppendorf snap‑cap tubes in slot 2; fill tube A1 with the desired volume of water for pooling. Place a second 4 × 6 aluminum block insert on the temperature module in slot 4 and load an empty 2 mL snap‑cap tube (tube A1) that will serve as the pool tube.

steps.title: Enter CSV and Parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol interface, load the sample‑volume `.csv` file, specify the total water volume to add to the pool (in µL), and set the mount sides for the P10 and P300 single‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Download Protocol File
steps.instruction: Click the “Download” button to save the generated Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload Protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, create a new protocol, and upload the downloaded Python file.

steps.title: Arrange Deck According to Map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the robot deck exactly as described: slot 2 – 4 × 6 tuberack with water tube; slot 4 – temperature module with aluminum block and empty pool tube; slot 9 – 96‑well PCR plate (elution plate); tip racks in the designated slots; pipettes mounted on the specified mounts.

steps.title: Calibrate Labware and Pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons App for each piece of labware, tip rack, and pipette, following the on‑screen prompts or support articles.

steps.title: Execute Protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the automated pooling transfers as defined in the CSV.
